title: Route
description: A football pass route defined as a polyline of waypoints from the receiver's start position. Mirror-aware: x positive in waypoints means INSIDE (toward center of field). The drawing tool flips x for receivers on the right side of the formation.

aliases.description: Alternate names for this route (used when plays reference it by a different name).

path.description: Polyline waypoints as [x, y] pairs in yards relative to receiver's start (which is [0,0]). x positive = toward INSIDE of field (center); y positive = downfield. Drawing tool mirrors x for right-side receivers.

typical_break_depth_yd.description: Depth (y) where the route changes direction. Useful for analytics.

option_route.description: True if the receiver reads coverage and adjusts post-snap (snag, stick, choice routes).

beats_coverage.description: Default coverage type this route is designed to attack. Per-play assignments can override via assignment.beats_coverage.
